metadata.selection_algorithm: For each domain in [blocksworld, miconic, transport] and difficulty in [easy, medium, hard], sort filenames lexicographically; derive a 64-bit stratum seed from the first 8 bytes of SHA256('5102:<domain>:<difficulty>'); use random.Random(seed).sample without replacement. Blocksworld easy-p03 is included first and nine other eligible easy problems are sampled. Selected records are sorted by the declared domain/difficulty order and filename.

inclusion_exceptions.reason: Predetermined proposal smoke-test instance; sample 9 from the other eligible files.
